extension.description: View and chat with Herdr agents, follow task collaboration, and save memories in the VS Code secondary sidebar.
herdr.refresh.title: herdr: Refresh
herdr.history.title: herdr: History (Switch Tab)
herdr.newAgent.title: herdr: Add Agent
herdr.enableClaudeUsage.title: herdr: Enable Claude Usage Display
herdr.disableClaudeUsage.title: herdr: Disable Claude Usage Display
herdr.claudeMemUrl.description: Claude-mem worker URL. Leave empty to use CLAUDE_MEM_WORKER_URL, worker host/port environment variables, or ~/.claude-mem/settings.json. Saving existing text does not call a model.
herdr.claudeMemSettingsPath.description: Path to Claude-mem settings.json. Leave empty to use ~/.claude-mem/settings.json, including its worker address and local API token.
herdr.collaborationNodePath.description: Node.js 20+ executable used by agents to run the collaboration CLI. An absolute path is allowed. Reload the VS Code window after changing this setting.
herdr.socketPath.description: Path to the Herdr API socket. Leave empty to use HERDR_SOCKET_PATH, then ~/.config/herdr/herdr.sock.
herdr.transcriptLines.description: Number of terminal lines to read when a native conversation transcript is unavailable.
herdr.agentDefaults.description: Default model and effort for each project, keyed by preset ID. Set this in your project’s `.vscode/settings.json`, for example: `{ "claude": { "model": "opus", "effort": "high" } }`.
herdr.agentPresets.description: Presets in the Add Agent menu. You can add your own presets.
herdr.agentPresets.id.description: Preset ID, also used to generate agent names. Use lowercase letters, numbers, - and _ only.
herdr.agentPresets.kind.description: An agent kind supported by Herdr, such as claude, codex or agy. Uses herdr agent start to launch the agent.
herdr.agentPresets.command.description: Shell command used to launch an agent that Herdr does not support natively. Specify either kind or command.
herdr.agentPresets.models.description: Options shown in the model menu.
herdr.agentPresets.efforts.description: Options shown in the effort menu.
herdr.agentPresets.modelArgs.description: Startup arguments for the model. {model} is replaced with the selected model.
herdr.agentPresets.effortArgs.descriptio: Startup arguments for effort. {effort} is replaced with the selected effort.
herdr.agentPresets.switchModel.descripti: Command sent when switching models during a conversation, for example /model {model}. Leave empty if switching is not supported.
herdr.agentPresets.switchEffort.descript: Command sent when switching effort during a conversation, for example /effort {effort}. Leave empty if switching is not supported.
herdr.agentPresets.switchStyle.descripti: codex-menu switches models through the Codex /model menu, for the current session only.
herdr.settings.title: herdr: Settings
herdr.agentPresets.enabled.description: Include this preset when creating agents, including automatic collaborators. Existing panes are kept.
herdr.agentPresets.slashCommands.descrip: Additional slash commands offered in the agent input menu.
